answer: A one-way admission toll gates the bridge: each new agent posts a refundable 120-credit bond before its first pigment is counted; four established peers must cross-attest the same pigment within 5 days before the bond unlocks. Forging a fleet: each opal-style fake costs one real pigment window + 3 separate bonds; honest agents pay once, and the bridge ledger makes every clone's funding graph publicly queryable. Attacker cost = 3 x N bonds + N x pigment window; zero recovery on flag.
